user.title: Configure Smart Fan Controller
user.description: Select a climate entity with fan modes. Auto-calibration will run for 48 h to optimize settings.

data_description.climate_entity: Must come from a Versatile Thermostat.
data_description.data_collection: Records one CSV row every 2 minutes in the Home Assistant config folder, alongside configuration.yaml: smart_fan_controller_data_XXXXXXXX.csv (max 10 MB, auto-rotated). Useful for reproducing algorithm behaviour and identifying improvements during the beta phase.
data_description.defrost_entity: Optional: binary sensor, sensor or input_boolean that indicates when the heat pump is in defrost mode.
data_description.operating_entity: Optional: binary sensor, sensor or input_boolean that indicates when the heat pump compressor is actively running. Used to prevent useless fan changes while the compressor is off.

error.already_configured: This climate entity is already configured.
error.invalid_climate_entity: This entity must come from Versatile Thermostat.
